title: Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: Delicious and flavorful Turkish-style lamb kebabs, perfect for a summer evening. Serve with a side of salad or rice.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, Turkish red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
